ns2:course.label: Arch Design & Development
ns2:course.description: Schematic design and development of a small-scale public building emphasizing the integration of the basic elements of building; materials, details, structure, technology, program, life safety, and universal design. 6 undergraduate hours. 6 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ARCH 374 or ARCH 472.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 6 undergraduate hours. 6 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ARCH 374 or ARCH 472.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Architectural Studies or Architecture major(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Architecture department.
